Game Overview

At its heart, Little Strawberry is a arcade game about guide a tiny strawberry through a hazardous forest using precise quadruple jumps. Timing and reflexes are crucial as you navigate this beautifully designed environment, striving to conquer each challenge and progress deeper into the vibrant wilderness. One wrong move, and it's game over—focus is your only ally.
